services.name: Surf Stories
services.desc: Join us for Summer Surf Camp! We accommodate all levels from first-timers to advanced riders ages 6-14 years old looking to enjoy a rewarding summer on the water. Each child will receive personal one-on-one training each time they ride behind the boat. To ensure your child has the best and safest experience on the water all of our equipment is top-of-the-line. The campers will be on board our Nautique Boats fleet. In between all the action on the water, there will be time for swimming and tubing to make irreplaceable summer memories with new friends! blurb: Coastal Wake offers luxury wakesports charter tours that can be customized for thrilling water sports, nature tours, or all-day escapes. Guests can try water sports for the first time, swim with dolphins, and picnic on private islands. The tours are guided by award-winning Experience Ambassadors including drone pilots, watersports instructors, and local guides.
